transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because my behavior has just been kind of all over the place lately. I went from barely settling into my new apartment to suddenly... saying yes to all these mentoring sessions. I started taking on extra client prototypes for work, and I even decided to completely redesign my whole portfolio. It was just like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint, and I realize that's probably something I should get checked out.
Have you been feeling unusually happy or energetic lately?

Yeah, I have. Earlier this month, I felt... well, almost electric and really upbeat. But it wasn't just that. It would shift quickly. Like, one minute I'm feeling great and full of energy, and the next I'd just snap at a contractor at work, or my sister, over really tiny delays. It just felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting things done.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling sad or depressed recently?

Yeah, I have. Lately, I've been waking up with this... this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. It's hard to explain, but even when my apartment is totally quiet and nothing bad is actually happening, I just feel so down. Like, I feel like I could just break down and cry over something as stupid as a coffee mug left in the sink.
How long do these periods of feeling sad or depressed usually last?

Well, they can drag on for a few weeks at a time once they start. But overall, these heavier depressive stretches have really been showing up since my separation... which was about 11 months ago. It's been happening since then, even before this latest move made everything feel a lot sharper.
Do you feel like your really energetic and productive periods are separate from your normal self, like they're distinct episodes?

Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought of it like that. It doesn't necessarily feel like a completely separate episode or... like I'm a different person, if that's what you mean. It just feels like me, but, I don't know, just a lot faster and more intense for a few days. So, I guess I wouldn't say I've noticed them being totally distinct from my normal self.
Do you feel like you can control when these really energetic and productive periods start and stop?

No, I don't think I can control it at all. It just sort of happens. One day I'll wake up and I'm just... go, go, go. And then a few days later, it just stops on its own. I can't really turn it on or off when I want to.
During these really energetic and productive periods, do you find that you need less sleep than usual?

Yes, definitely. For several nights during those times, I'll only sleep maybe three or four hours. But the thing is, I'll wake up convinced I'm totally fine. I don't feel tired at all, so I just figure I should use the extra time to get up and get ahead on my work.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight during your periods of feeling sad or depressed?

Yeah, I have. Um... when I'm feeling down, most days food just feels like another task on my list. So I end up just picking at crackers, or I'll order something and barely even touch it. Because of that, I've definitely lost some weight. My jeans have started hanging a lot looser than they did when I moved in.
Have you felt irritable, or has your mood been elevated, for most of the day for several days in a row?

Yes, definitely. Um, earlier this month, for a few days in a row, I felt almost... electric, I guess? Just really upbeat. But then it would flip, and I'd get incredibly irritable. Like, I snapped at a contractor I was working with, and then at my sister, over these tiny delays. It just felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting my work done. So yeah, it's definitely been both elevated and irritable like that for days at a time.
During those really energetic and productive periods, do you ever feel like you're capable of accomplishing anything you set your mind to, almost like you're invincible?

No, I wouldn't say I feel invincible. I just feel like I have a lot of energy and focus to get things done, but I don't think I have any special powers or that I can do absolutely anything. It's more just about being really productive and driven with my design work, not feeling like I'm on top of the world or anything like that.
Do you ever feel unusually important or special during those really energetic and productive periods?

No, not really. I mean, I know I'm good at my job, but I don't feel like I'm suddenly, you know, a genius or more important than anyone else. I just feel really capable of doing the work in front of me. That's about it.
Do you ever have thoughts that you're more important or have special powers during these energetic periods?

No, I don't. Like I was just saying, I don't feel invincible or like I have any kind of special powers. I'm just a designer getting a lot of work done quickly. I don't think I'm suddenly someone famous or that I have some grand purpose. It's just... it's just a lot of energy, that's all.
Do you ever feel like you have a special connection to something bigger than yourself or a special mission during those energetic periods?

No, really, I don't. Um... it's kind of like I was just saying, I don't feel like I have a grand purpose or some special mission. I'm just designing websites. It's my normal life, I just happen to be working a lot faster and with more focus. But no, there's no special connection to the universe or anything like that.
Do you ever have thoughts that you're more important than others during these energetic periods?

No, I really don't. I feel like I keep repeating myself here, but... no. I don't think I'm better or more important than anyone else. I just have a lot of drive to get my design work done during those times. That's really all it is.
Do you think these really energetic and productive periods of yours have caused any problems for you or those around you?

Yeah, they actually have. Um, I completely missed a really important design review at work recently. And honestly, I've been avoiding my friends and family a lot lately, too. I just feel really embarrassed about how scattered and unreliable I've seemed to everyone. So, yes, it definitely causes some issues.
Have you ever had a period of elevated or irritable mood that lasted at least four consecutive days?

Yeah, I have. Um, just earlier this month, actually, I had a stretch like that. I felt almost electric and really upbeat one minute, and then... I don't know, I'd just get incredibly irritated. I ended up snapping at a contractor I work with, and my sister too, over really tiny delays. It felt like they were personally trying to block me from getting my work done. And yeah, that definitely went on for at least four or five days straight.
Have you ever engaged in activities that could have serious consequences, like excessive spending or reckless behavior, during those really energetic and productive periods?

Yes, I have. Um, mostly with spending. When I get in that zone, I just don't really think about the cost of things. 

Like, recently I ended up buying these really expensive light fixtures, and a bunch of premium design software add-ons. I even booked a last-minute flight for a trip that I really couldn't afford. In the moment, it all felt completely necessary, but... yeah, it was only later when I looked at my bank account that I realized how badly it actually hit my savings.
How many days in a row have you typically felt this extremely energetic and productive during these episodes?

Um, I'm not entirely sure exactly how many days it usually lasts. I know the one earlier this month was maybe four or five days, like I said, but... I don't really track the exact number of days for every single time it happens. It's usually just a few days in a row where I feel like that.
Have you had two or more major depressive episodes in the past year?

Yeah, I have. Um, these heavier depressive stretches... they've really been showing up since my separation, which was about 11 months ago. And that was even before this latest move, which honestly just made everything feel sharper. So, yeah, there have definitely been a few of those periods over the last year.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely energetic and productive, but it didn't last long enough to be considered a full manic episode?

Um, well, I guess that's what I was just talking about, right? Those periods where I get really focused and get a ton of work done, and end up spending too much money... they usually only last a few days, like four or five. So, yeah, I guess that fits what you're asking. I've never had it last longer than that, or get to a point where I felt completely out of control, if that's what a full manic episode is.
